args.title: Separate error toasts into assertive region without auto-dismiss in Toast.tsx
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Update ToastProvider to separate error toasts into an assertive region with no auto-dismiss, while leaving info and success toasts polite and auto-dismissing.

label: bug
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Toast.tsx currently renders all toasts in a single container with role="status" and aria-live="polite", and every toast has a 5-second setTimeout auto-dismiss timer. We will update ToastProvider to separate error toasts into an assertive region with no auto-dismiss, while leaving info and success toasts polite and auto-dismissing.
